description: A shell script for bringing up a Kubernetes cluster, including downloading binaries, validating versions, and creating the cluster.

methods.name: set_binary_version
methods.description: Sets the KUBE_VERSION variable based on input, resolving version strings or paths.

methods.name: download_kube_binaries
methods.description: Fetches Kubernetes client and server binaries from within the Kubernetes tarball.

methods.name: create_cluster
methods.description: Creates a Kubernetes cluster by running the kube-up.sh script inside the kubernetes directory.

methods.name: valid-storage-scope
methods.description: Checks GCE metadata for storage scope permissions.
